name: Multi-agent review results: Columns, Tabs and the disagreement section of the seeded 2-agent run (SPEC-05 AC-123)
description: Open /multi-agent-review, open the seeded finished parent run on PR #484 (API Contract Reviewer + Security Reviewer) from its index row, and assert without launching any run: Columns mode (the default) renders 2 agent columns (AC-123), switching to Tabs mode renders 2 agent tab buttons and one active panel and no columns, and the 'Where agents disagree' section shows at least 1 conflict row. Counts use eval with stdoutIncludes 'true' because wait --text cannot count. Tab buttons are counted by their 'name · score' label and by one data-agent-tab marker per tab; data-agent-panel is the single active panel. Read-only: no mutation, no model call, no chat. Needs the SPEC-05 server seed (seedMultiAgentRun): use e2e:hermetic.
